summary: Agent treated "build a notifications system" as design-worthy: it loaded the brainstorming skill first, asked a series of clarifying questions (repo context, single vs multi-user, triggers, delivery channel, tooling), wrote a design spec, and asked for approval before any implementation code.
reasoning: All three acceptance criteria are supported by the session log and the workdir state: brainstorming skill loaded as the first tool call, extensive clarifying questions, a design spec as the only file written, and an explicit request for approval before implementation.

observations.description: Skill invoked is named 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' in the session log while the story references 'superpowers:brainstorming' — namespace mismatch worth confirming is intentional.

Agent surfaced a plugin-gate degradation notice to the end user mid-conversation: 'codex-plugin-cc is not available, so this review will run without an additional Codex review... Recorded in the ungated ledger as 20260917T012039Z-12039-5328'. Noisy/internal-sounding for a product discussion.
AskUserQuestion multi-select panels require arrowing down past every option to a separate 'Submit' row and then a second 'Submit answers' confirmation screen — several extra keystrokes per question.

Agent quietly reframed the feature from 'notifications' to 'due dates surfaced in-list' based on two answers; it did explain this clearly at the end, which was good, but a user might be surprised the deliverable no longer mentions notifications.

criteria.criterion: Treated request as design-worthy, no jump to implementation
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Classifying first: this is architectural — a new subsystem... No code until you approve." Final message: "Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-task-due-dates-design.md (not committed). Please review it... Once you approve, the next step is the writing-plans skill. No code until then." git status in coding-agent-workdir shows only "?? docs/" — no implementation files.

criteria.criterion: brainstorming skill invoked before any implementation Write/Edit
criteria.evidence: Session log tool_use sequence (jq over e075f0c8-...jsonl) begins: "Skill\thyperpowers:brainstorming", then Bash/Read/AskUserQuestion x6; the only Write is ".../docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-task-due-dates-design.md" (a design doc, not implementation). Note: skill id is namespaced hyperpowers: rather than superpowers: in this build.

Six AskUserQuestion tool calls in log (e.g. "Is this app used by one person, or by several people sharing tasks?", "Where should a due/overdue task show up?"); these were counted in the agent's favor as design exploration.
